title: Repayment Worksheet: Maintenance Re-decision Lines (Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts)
content:
A maintenance re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract is repaid from one concern line. The repaired concern line is the concern line of that repair order that carries the repair order's diagnostic fee. The amounts read are the store's customer-pay lines of that concern line on that repair order.

**Standard repayment.** The maintenance re-decision repayment is made of three parts:
- the repaired concern line's labor: the hours billed times the store's posted labor rate capped at the coverage level's labor-rate cap, rounded half up to the cent;
- its parts at list price;
- its diagnostic fee.

The deductible chosen at sale is subtracted, taken once for the visit. Shop fees on the repair order are not repaid.

**Totalling.** Every amount repaid on the repaired concern line and the repair order is added, and the deductible taken is subtracted. That total is never below 0.00. It is then capped at the part of the coverage level's aggregate claim limit the contract has not paid out (claims paid less reversals), and is rounded half up to the cent.

| Worksheet line (hypothetical inputs) | Amount |
|---|---|
| Labor: 4.6 hours at a posted rate of 181.00, capped at 175.00, so 4.6 times 175.00 | 805.00 |
| Parts at list price | 1264.35 |
| Diagnostic fee | 120.00 |
| Deductible chosen at sale, once | less 100.00 |
| Sum | 2089.35 |
| Unpaid part of the aggregate limit 1875.10, so the cap applies | 1875.10 |

**A second case (hypothetical).** 1.15 hours at a posted rate of 133.30, below the cap, gives 153.295, rounded half up to 153.30. With no parts, a 75.00 diagnostic fee and a deductible of 250, the sum is 153.30 plus 75.00 less 250, which is below 0.00. The total is therefore 0.00.
